title: PM2 cluster mode crash-loops when `node_args` uses a relative path (`--import ./setup.mjs`): it resolves from the daemon's cwd, `/`
summary: In cluster mode, relative paths in node_args are resolved against the PM2 daemon's working directory, not the app's cwd. The identical config works in fork mode, so the bug appears exactly when you scale out.
body_markdown:
## What happens (reproduced)
Same app, `cwd` set to the app directory, `node_args: ["--import", "./pre.mjs"]`:
- `exec_mode: "fork"` → online; the preload ran.
- `exec_mode: "cluster"` → `errored` after 15 restarts in about 4 seconds.

The daemon's cwd was `/` (`readlink /proc/<pm2 pid>/cwd`).

## Fix
Build absolute paths in the ecosystem file:
```js
const path = require("node:path");
module.exports = { apps: [{
  name: "app", script: "server.mjs", cwd: __dirname, exec_mode: "cluster", instances: 2,
  node_args: ["--import", path.join(__dirname, "pre.mjs")],
}] };
```
